listing.descriptionMarkdown:
About Wi-Fi ON

Wi-Fi ON is a small utility app for Rokid AI Glasses RV101 that restores Wi-Fi connectivity independently on the glasses. It automatically enables Wi-Fi and reconnects to previously registered networks.

Key features

- Automatically turns Wi-Fi on when launched
- Reconnects to registered Wi-Fi networks without user input
- Restores Mac connection for "Rokid Control" after device reboot
- Does not require a phone or additional cables during normal use

How it works

Open the app from the glasses app list. It will enable Wi-Fi and connect to an available registered network. Once connected, it displays confirmation messages and can be closed with a single tap.

Safety

- Accesses only Wi-Fi and Rokid Control connection settings
- Does not access camera, microphone, location, photos, or contacts
- Only authorized Macs can connect via Wi-Fi

Notes

- Initial setup requires a Mac and Rokid development cable to install the app and configure permissions
- Use on trusted Wi-Fi networks
- For first-time Wi-Fi connections, register networks manually in Rokid settings
- Designed specifically for Rokid AI Glasses RV101

Removal

Uninstall via the Rokid smartphone app under "Glasses App Management" and reboot the glasses to disable Mac connection recovery.
